hook: Condo rents barely moved in October. Is renting out still worth it?
myth: Rents only go up, so any condo I buy to rent out will pay for itself.
fact: Condo rents rose just 0.1% in October and leases fell 9.3% from September. HDB rents rose 0.5%. Yields now depend on the unit, not the market.
take: Run the numbers on the unit, not on the headline.
sources: Source: SRX and 99.co rental flash, October 2026
